mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a backyard home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an initial consultation, identify your primary goals for the space, such as whether it needs step-free universal access, a full kitchen, or private laundry facilities. It is also helpful to locate your property survey to confirm property boundaries and note where your main electrical panel and plumbing tie-ins sit relative to the yard. Having a general budget range and a prioritized list of essential features versus optional upgrades helps streamline the design and estimating process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify your main electrical and plumbing locations, determine essential accessibility needs, and clarify your budget before your consultation.
